name: Button
description: Standard push button. Should be activatable with Space or Enter and announce its label.
expectations:
Role: Button
Keyboard: Space/Enter to activate
Screen reader: announces label and pressed state

name: TextCtrl
description: Single-line and multi-line text inputs. Editable text should expose caret position and value.
expectations:
Role: Text / Edit
Keyboard: Arrow keys, Home/End, Ctrl+A
Screen reader: announces role and current text

name: ListBox
description: Single and multi-select lists used for selecting items. Should support keyboard selection and range selection.
expectations:
Role: List
Keyboard: Arrow keys, Shift+arrow for range, Ctrl+Space to toggle in multi-select
Screen reader: announces item text and position

name: TreeCtrl
description: Hierarchical tree control for nested items. Expand/collapse with keyboard and announce parent/child relationships.
expectations:
Role: Tree
Keyboard: Left/Right to collapse/expand, Arrow keys to navigate
Screen reader: announces hierarchy and expanded/collapsed state

name: Grid
description: Spreadsheet-like grid for tabular data. Cells should be addressable and editable with clear row/column labels.
expectations:
Role: Grid/Table
Keyboard: Arrow keys to move between cells, Enter to edit
Screen reader: announces cell coordinates and value
